items.content:
Three ingredients and I have broken the sauce more ways than seems
mathematically possible. The trick nobody says out loud: the pan has to be
off the heat before the cheese goes in, or you get a pot of expensive
grit.

**Mar 4** — took the pan off the heat first. Emulsion held. Two years of
grit and it was a temperature the whole time.

**Apr 1** — did it for Sid. Held again. I am choosing to believe I have
learned this and not that I got lucky twice.

summary: Pan off the heat before the cheese is the whole trick
title: cacio e pepe, attempt whatever
